_about: How each filing treats the IMM, read from the quoted passages only (not the full document). Key = control number # item number. Stances: Supports, Disputes, Mixed, Asks (wants the IMM to do something), Cites (uses IMM work as a reference), Responds (official response to IMM work).

34677#27.note: Staff's position on each of the 12 recommendations in the 2025 State of the Market report.

34677#28.note: Records that the commission lifted its 2019 constraint on demand curve design, as the IMM recommended.

54445#164.note: ERCOT's Board reports state the IMM's opinion on each revision request.

55999#273.note: Argues the IMM favors market solutions yet opposes ancillary service quantities set by ERCOT's reliability goals.

55999#275.note: Joint Consumers say they and the IMM have consistently opposed the model as over-procuring.

55999#277.note: Quotes Jeff McDonald's call for an off-ramp from conservative operations.

55999#280.note: Staff lists the IMM among the parties recommending approval.

55999#283.note: The order notes the IMM was among seven commenters.

58000#14.note: Uses the IMM's figure on crypto mining's share of Emergency Response Service.

58000#31.note: Says the IMM has flagged for years that loads cut usage to avoid transmission charges.

58000#50.note: Says the IMM has named dynamic line rating a priority for congestion.

58482#40.note: Supports IMM review of each auction to confirm it was competitive.

58482#53.note: Notes the IMM also recommended the service be available in any event with material risk of load shed.

58482#61.note: Concurs with the IMM that a fixed budget does not fit sporadic extreme weather.

58555#24.note: ERCOT's cost allocation report references IMM statements on Firm Fuel Supply Service.

58555#27.note: Uses State of the Market figures on ancillary service costs.

58555#30.note: Prefers the IMM's ground-up cost causation approach.

58555#34.note: Cites the IMM's 2025 ancillary service methodology comments.

58555#35.note: Calls the IMM's earlier work a useful starting point.

58555#36.note: Says the IMM and consumers have consistently opposed ERCOT's methodology as overstating needs.

59550#6.note: Backs tying each demand curve to marginal reliability value, citing recommendation 2024-1a.

59550#7.note: ERCOT says it looks forward to working with the IMM on demand curve changes.

59550#8.note: Cites the State of the Market report but wants options beyond those ERCOT and the IMM present.

59550#9.note: Uses the IMM's analysis of the implied value of lost load.

59550#10.note: Says the demand curves are leaner than the old curve because of changes the IMM requested.

59550#12.note: Notes the IMM backed the original co-optimization design decisions.

59550#14.note: Cites the IMM's good cause exception comments.

59550#15.note: Asks the commission to direct ERCOT and the IMM to model pricing under alternative demand curve designs.

59550#16.note: Uses State of the Market figures on shortage pricing hours.
